record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: For a cubic fourfold X, is X rational if and only if its Kuznetsov component Ku(X) is equivalent to the bounded derived category of a K3 surface?

evidence.quote: whether the rationality of X can be detected by Ku(X)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^5_{\mathbb{C}}$ be a smooth cubic fourfold, i.e. a smooth hypersurface of degree $3$ in complex projective $5$-space. Consider its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves $D^b(X)$. By results of Kuznetsov, there is a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathrm{Ku}(X),\, \mathcal{O}_X,\, \mathcal{O}_X(1),\, \mathcal{O}_X(2)\rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ is defined as the right orthogonal
$$\mathrm{Ku}(X) := \{ E \in D^b(X) \;:\; \mathrm{Hom}^\bullet(\mathcal{O}_X(i), E) = 0 \text{ for } i = 0,1,2 \}.$$
The subcategory $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ is a $\mathbb{C}$-linear triangulated category whose Serre functor is the shift by $2$, so it is a "noncommutative K3 surface". Recall that $X$ is said to be rational if there exists a birational map $X \dashrightarrow \mathbb{P}^4$ over $\mathbb{C}$.

Prove or disprove: a smooth cubic fourfold $X$ is rational if and only if there exists a smooth projective K3 surface $S$ over $\mathbb{C}$ such that $\mathrm{Ku}(X)$ is $\mathbb{C}$-linearly triangulated-equivalent to $D^b(S)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The Kuznetsov rationality conjecture for cubic fourfolds remains a major open problem. While necessary and sufficient lattice-theoretic conditions for $\mathrm{Ku}(X) \simeq D^b(S)$ have been established (Addington–Thomas, and refined by Bayer–Lahoz–Macrì–Nuer–Perry–Stellari), and all known rational cubic fourfolds satisfy the conjecture, no proof of equivalence with rationality exists, and no smooth cubic fourfold has been proven irrational.

status_evidence.title: Addington–Thomas: Hodge theory and derived categories of cubic fourfolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes equivalence of Hassett's Hodge-theoretic conditions with the existence of a K3 category equivalence, generically; rationality conjecture stated as open.
status_evidence.claim: Conjectural link between Ku(X) ≃ D^b(K3) and rationality remains open.

status_evidence.title: Bayer–Lahoz–Macrì–Nuer–Perry–Stellari, Stability conditions on Kuznetsov components
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Kuznetsov's conjecture on rationality of cubic fourfolds as still-open.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is referenced as open in recent literature.
